title: Home as the stall plus swipeable mode cards, and a saved game per mode
problem: Home is a long page; the League and the Daily are repeated on the Play page; one saved game slot means starting any game replaces a game in another mode.
scope: Home: the player's stall with every look they wear (roof, trim, colour, hat, frame, prop, sign), level and next unlock
Three swipeable cards in the same style: Play (opens the Play page), Market League (stage, stars, next trophy, opens the League), Daily market (today's customer and lorry, the Sprint row, your place)
The League and the Daily removed from the Play page
A Daily intro screen before a Daily or Sprint game: what the mode is, today's twist, rivals, how you are scored and ranked, retries, then Start

A saved game per mode (Play: computer or one phone; League; Daily; Sprint), each shown on its card with Continue; old single saves migrate to their mode; Settings, How to play, Account, Stamp book and Wardrobe stay reachable
exclusions: No rule, balance or protocol change
Online matches keep their room (Back to room), not a save slot

acceptance.text: npm run verify with save-slot and migration tests (old saves still load)
npm run test:e2e with the new Home and the Daily intro

approval.evidence: Owner, 2026-11-22: "reword the current homescreen layout, maintain the same style but it should be; players stall with whatever customisations they unlocked; swipeable cards for 1. play, which opens up the play page 2. market league 2. daily market; market league and daily market should be removed from the play page since both are getting a separate card; users should be prompted after clicking daily market, design a screen to explain the objective of the game mode and what it does before starting a game; saved game for before should each appear at each card's game mode" (with two screenshots of the current Home)
